description: Tools to extract data from Gmsh models and create DOLFINx meshes.

classes.name: MeshData
classes.description: NamedTuple: (mesh, cell_tags, facet_tags, ridge_tags, peak_tags, physical_groups).

classes.name: PhysicalGroup
classes.description: NamedTuple: (dim, tag) for physical group info.

classes.name: TopologyDict
classes.description: TypedDict for storing topology of marked cells: topology, cell_data, entity_tags.

functions.name: model_to_mesh
functions.signature: model_to_mesh(model, comm, rank, gdim, partitioner=None, dtype=None, max_facet_to_cell_links=1)
functions.description: Create a Mesh from a Gmsh model. Returns MeshData with mesh, tags by codimension, and physical groups.
notes: For performance, call only once for large problems. Save with XDMFFile for reuse.

functions.name: read_from_msh
functions.description: Read a Gmsh .msh file and return MeshData. Requires Gmsh Python module.

functions.name: cell_perm_array
functions.description: Array for permuting Gmsh ordering to DOLFINx ordering.

functions.name: extract_geometry
functions.description: Extract mesh geometry from Gmsh model. Returns array of shape (num_nodes, 3).

functions.name: extract_topology_and_markers
functions.description: Extract entities with physical markers from Gmsh model.

functions.name: ufl_mesh
functions.description: Create UFL mesh from Gmsh cell identifier and geometric dimension.
